title: Primary, secondary and tertiary alcohols
caption: The class depends on how many carbons are attached to the carbon bearing –OH: one (primary), two (secondary) or three (tertiary). The class decides what oxidation gives: aldehyde then acid, ketone, or no reaction.
alt: Butan-1-ol, butan-2-ol and 2-methylpropan-2-ol, all C₄H₁₀O, with the carbon bearing OH shaded.
description: Butan-1-ol: the C–OH carbon has one carbon attached: primary.
